newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - GOLDMAN KEEPS OUTOKUMPU BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - GOLDMAN KEEPS OUTOKUMPU BUY.

text.p: Goldman Sachs said on Tuesday it had reiterated a "buy" recommendation for Finnish mining and metals group Outokumpu and set a new 115 markka 12-month share price target.
"The new target price is 115 markka," Goldman Sachs analyst Melanie Hucherard told Reuters by telephone.
Hucherard raised her forecast for Outokumpu's full-year 1997 earnings per share by 13 percent from the earlier forecast to 7.7 markka, and the 1998 forecast by four percent to 10.1 markka.
"Based on 1997 and 1998 EPS, Outokumpu shares are trading at a 10 to 15 percent premium to both European and U.S. stainless steel producers," Hucherard said.

In a research note dated May 12, Goldman said the premium could be justified if there were larger contributions from the non-stainless steel businesses, unit cost improvements from expansion programmes and acceleration of growth in Europe.
Goldman forecast Outokumpu's first tertial EPS at 1.62 markka (versus 1.54 markka in the year-ago period).
Outokumpu will release its January-April results on June 5.
